WITH sales AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year=2002 AND d.d_moy=9
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt),0) AS return_amt,
  (SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) FROM sales) AS net_paid
FROM sales s
JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number
 AND sr.sr_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk;

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year=2002 AND d.d_moy=9
)
SELECT ROUND(
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sr.sr_return_amt)
            FROM sales s JOIN store_returns sr
              ON sr.sr_ticket_number=s.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk=s.ss_item_sk),0)
  / (SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) FROM sales) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct;
